description: Implementation of a mock network change notifier class used for testing network state changes, including methods to simulate network events and manage observers.

classes.name: MockNetworkChangeNotifier
classes.description: A mock class for simulating network change events for testing purposes.

classes.name: ScopedMockNetworkChangeNotifier
classes.description: A RAII helper class to manage a scoped instance of MockNetworkChangeNotifier for tests.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of MockNetworkChangeNotifier with a disabled system DNS config notifier.

methods.name: ~MockNetworkChangeNotifier
methods.description: Destructor that stops the system DNS config notifier.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectionType
methods.description: Returns the current network connection type.

methods.name: ForceNetworkHandlesSupported
methods.description: Forces the support of network handles.

methods.name: AreNetworkHandlesCurrentlySupported
methods.description: Checks if network handles are currently supported.

methods.name: SetConnectedNetworksList
methods.description: Sets the list of currently connected networks.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectedNetworks
methods.description: Retrieves the list of currently connected networks.

methods.name: NotifyNetworkMadeDefault
methods.description: Simulates a network being set as default and notifies observers.

methods.name: NotifyNetworkDisconnected
methods.description: Simulates a network disconnection and notifies observers.

methods.name: NotifyNetworkConnected
methods.description: Simulates a network connection and notifies observers.

methods.name: IsDefaultNetworkActiveInternal
methods.description: Checks if the default network is active.

methods.name: SetConnectionTypeAndNotifyObservers
methods.description: Sets the connection type and notifies observers of the change.
